about: The trainer AI tells snow from hail where they part (trainer_ai_script.c 05CE): Hail replaces snow (effect script 164), so under snow it is no repeat. The player's Marill uses Snowscape; Falkner's Hoothoot, taught Hail and Leer once the battle is up, uses Hail under the snow and brings hail. Before the fix the weather command read snow as hail, flag 0 took 8 off Hail as a repeat, and the Hoothoot Leered while it snowed.
